title: DevBench — Settings · Config
subtitle: AmigaOS 4.1 on QEMU sam460ex · profile qemu-os4 · :3000

items.label: Serial link
items.text: TCP or PTY, and the host:port the emulator exposes the Amiga serial port on.

items.label: Emulator
items.text: Emulator binary / launcher, its config file, and whether devbench starts it.

items.label: Crash handler
items.text: Enable the bridge's crash handler automatically when the daemon starts.

items.label: Deploy dir
items.text: Where builds are deployed: a shared folder (68k) or the dev HDF written with xdftool (OS4).

items.label: Emulator config editor
items.text: Edits the FS-UAE config file named in the profile (Save, Reload, Save & Restart). Empty here: the qemu-os4 profile launches QEMU through a script and has no FS-UAE config.
